job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled Backend Engineer to join our team in Bangalore, responsible for developing and maintaining the server-side logic of GenAI. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development and experience with AI technologies.



Roles and Responsibility




Design, develop, and test backend systems using various programming languages and frameworks.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.


Develop and maintain high-quality, scalable, and efficient codebases.


Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently.


Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall code quality.


Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies in AI and backend development.




Job Requirements




Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.


Experience with AI technologies like machine learning, natural language processing, or computer vision is preferred.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively.


Strong understanding of software development principles, patterns, and practices.


Familiarity with agile development methodologies and version control systems like Git.




About Company



Wohlig Transformations is a leading company in the field of AI and backend development, committed to delivering innovative solutions that drive business growth. We are a team of experienced professionals passionate about staying ahead of the curve and pushing the boundaries of what is possible in AI technology.
